body: Still open when AUDIT.md was retired (6 Nov 2026; the file is now the frozen section `audit` of docs/history/reviews-2026-10-31.md): F24: "When I first opened Encore I had to type the server address. How come it did not detect that there is a server around, or at least ask me to scan a QR code?" || *Checked.* Not built: ADR-R40 slice B (link and QR) and slice C (the phone finds servers on the Wi-Fi by itself). The app asks for an address, a name and a password | **P2-19 slices B and C move to the front**: scanning is the first thing the first screen offers, a server on the same Wi-Fi is shown by name, and the typed address is last under "Other ways"
